notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake, targeting Scholar of the Ages
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.
